+// Copyright Kani Contributors
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
+// compile-flags: --edition 2021 -D warnings
+// kani-flags: -Z uninit-checks --output-format=regular
+
+use std::mem::MaybeUninit;
+
+#[inline(never)]
+fn invoke_once<F>(function: F) -> MaybeUninit<u16>
+where
+    F: FnOnce() -> MaybeUninit<u16>,
+{
+    function()
+}
+
+// Initialized companion of the Item-return uninit negative.
+// Preserve true initialization state through the same noinline generic call.
+#[kani::proof]
+fn item_return_preserves_initialized_value() {
+    let result = invoke_once(|| MaybeUninit::new(7u16));
+    assert_eq!(unsafe { result.assume_init() }, 7);
+}

+// Copyright Kani Contributors
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
+// compile-flags: --edition 2021 -D warnings
+// kani-flags: -Z uninit-checks --output-format=regular
+
+use std::mem::MaybeUninit;
+
+#[inline(never)]
+fn invoke_once<F>(function: F) -> MaybeUninit<u16>
+where
+    F: FnOnce() -> MaybeUninit<u16>,
+{
+    function()
+}
+
+// The closure call was reported as Item in the pinned Quick. Returning false
+// initialization state must preserve the reached assume_init read failure.
+#[kani::proof]
+fn item_return_preserves_uninitialized_read() {
+    let result = invoke_once(|| MaybeUninit::uninit());
+    let _read = unsafe { result.assume_init() };
+}

+// Copyright Kani Contributors
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
+// compile-flags: --edition 2021 -D warnings
+// kani-flags: -Z uninit-checks --output-format=regular
+
+use std::mem::MaybeUninit;
+
+#[inline(never)]
+fn invoke_once<F>(function: F, value: MaybeUninit<u16>)
+where
+    F: FnOnce(MaybeUninit<u16>),
+{
+    function(value);
+}
+
+// FnOnce wraps the MaybeUninit argument in a compound tuple.
+// Expect the tuple-layout Unsupported before any direct-shadow Shim guard.
+// This does not cover the direct-shadow-argument guard.
+#[kani::proof]
+fn tuple_maybe_uninit_layout_is_unsupported() {
+    invoke_once(|_value| {}, MaybeUninit::uninit());
+}
